name: Large File Upload Under Concurrent Load
stimulus: 50 concurrent users each upload files between 1 GB and 100 GB into different data rooms simultaneously
response: All uploads complete without timeout or data corruption; upload progress is visible in real time; server-side encryption is applied transparently

name: Unauthorized Access Attempt on E2E-Encrypted Data Room
environment: Production, attacker has stolen a valid session token
stimulus: An attacker with a stolen session token attempts to download files from an end-to-end encrypted data room without knowledge of the SecuPass key
response: Files are returned as ciphertext only; the server has no access to the plaintext; the attacker cannot decrypt the content; the access attempt is recorded in the audit trail with timestamp and user identity

name: Role Downgrade Must Immediately Restrict Access
stimulus: A data room owner downgrades an active editor to viewer without download while that user has an open browser session
response: The downgraded user's download and upload capabilities are revoked within 5 seconds; any in-progress download is terminated; the role change is recorded in the audit trail

name: Audit Trail Completeness Under Normal Operations
stimulus: A data room owner requests the full audit trail for a data room with 200 files after 6 months of activity involving 30 users
response: All file uploads, downloads, views, deletions, permission changes, and login events are present in the trail with correct user identity and timestamps; the report is generated within 10 seconds; no events are missing

name: New SSO Identity Provider Integration
stimulus: A new enterprise customer requires integration of their own SAML 2.0 identity provider for Single Sign-On
response: The SSO integration is configured and deployed without changes to core file management or encryption logic; integration is complete within 2 business days; existing users are unaffected

name: Data Room Access After Owner Account Deletion
stimulus: An admin deletes the sole owner account of an active data room containing critical project files
response: The system prevents deletion if no co-owner exists, or automatically reassigns ownership to a designated successor; files remain accessible to authorised members; no data is lost

name: Automatic Deletion of Expired Data Rooms
stimulus: A configured deletion deadline is reached for a data room containing 10,000 files using up 500 GB
response: All files and metadata are deleted within the scheduled maintenance window; affected owners receive a prior notification email; a deletion event is written to the audit log; storage is reclaimed within 24 hours
